description: This file implements a SensorsSimulator class for simulating sensor data such as accelerometer, gyroscope, and magnetometer readings based on rotation angles. It includes functions for computing rotation matrices, sensor data updates, and data retrieval, primarily used within the Android Open Source Project's sensors simulation framework.

classes.name: SensorsSimulator
classes.description: A class that simulates sensor data such as accelerometer, gyroscope, and magnetometer readings based on rotation angles.

methods.name: SensorsSimulator::SensorsSimulator
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the sensor simulator with auto mode and sets initial sensor data.

methods.name: SensorsSimulator::RefreshSensors
methods.description: Updates sensor data based on new rotation angles (x, y, z).

methods.name: SensorsSimulator::GetSensorsData
methods.description: Returns a string containing the current sensor data filtered by a mask.
